Xinghai Square
From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
Jump to: navigation, search
the musical fountain in Xinghai SquareXinghai Square, or Xinghai Plaza (Chinese: 星海广场; Pinyin: Xīnghăi Guăngchăng), is a city square in Dalian, China. It is located to the north of Xinghai Bay. Its total area is 45,000 m². Its name literally means "the Sea of Stars".
Xinghai Square was built in 1994. Its center looks like a star, with two White Marble Cloud Pillars (华表), and 9 giant dings.

For 10 days in late July-early August, Xinghai Square holds the annual International Beer Festival.
